title: Regional capacity forecast & rollout timeline Q4-2025 to Q2-2026
content:
Purpose:
Short regional capacity forecast across NA / EU / APAC to inform Dedicated and Hosted capacity commitments and Private deployment timelines. Focus window: 2025-Q4 through 2026-Q2. This is a working sheet: numbers are estimates, callouts list assumptions and open questions.

Executive summary:
- Net add of capacity across regions driven by hosted demand and two enterprise Reserved Dedicated deals forecast in Q1 2026.
- Prioritize NA (us-east/us-west) for low-latency hosting and Dedicated pools; EU follows for compliance and capacity isolation; APAC ramp will be staged to avoid overspend and to validate H100 performance in region.
- Target steady-state utilization: 62% (hosted baseline) with 20% headroom buffer for burst and canary rollouts.

Assumptions (high level):
- Typical model mix: 65% medium LLMs (8-20B), 30% large LLMs (70B-180B), 5% embeddings/other.
- Instance types planned: A100 80GB and H100 80GB (H100 trial in EU and APAC before full rollout).
- Cost assumptions (cloud list price estimate): A100-hour = $3.20, H100-hour = $7.20 (spot savings not guaranteed for Dedicated).
- Average tokens/sec per GPU estimated from current benchmarks: medium models ~220 tok/s, large models ~70 tok/s.
- We maintain 20% spare capacity for regional failover and autoscaling headroom.

Capacity table (planned active GPUs by month, rolling forecast)
Format: Month | NA (A100/H100) | EU (A100/H100) | APAC (A100/H100) | Notes
2025-10 | 240/0 | 120/0 | 40/0 | baseline (actual)
2025-11 | 260/8 | 130/0 | 45/0 | H100 pilot hardware procurement begins (NA)
2025-12 | 300/16 | 140/4 | 50/0 | holiday season headroom, small EU H100 pilot
2026-01 | 360/32 | 160/8 | 60/4 | Dedicated commit1 expected (NA) -> +40 GPUs net (reserved A100-equivalent)
2026-02 | 420/48 | 180/16 | 75/8 | scale for growth + enterprise onboarding; APAC H100 trial starts in region
2026-03 | 480/64 | 220/24 | 100/16 | Pre-rollout for Dedicated commit2 (EU Dedicated lead)
2026-04 | 540/80 | 280/32 | 140/24 | Post-Dedicated2 full provisioning begins (mix A100/H100)
2026-05 | 600/96 | 340/40 | 180/32 | Steady ramp; autoscaling tuning in NA and EU
2026-06 | 660/112 | 400/48 | 220/40 | Target capacity for Q2 closeout; review utilization targets

Target utilization and economics (monthly averages)
- NA target utilization: 65% peak, 55% off-peak. Effective utilization after batching/caching: +8–12% token throughput improvement.
- EU target utilization: 62% peak (allowing for compliance routing), 50% off-peak.
- APAC target utilization: 48–55% initially during H100 validation, target 60% after Q2.
- Expected blended cost per effective GPU-hour (after batching gains and spot where possible): NA $2.45, EU $2.90, APAC $3.10.

Rollout timeline & milestones (by region)
- NA (priority):
  - Nov 2025: H100 pilot on one cluster (internal performance validation).
  - Jan 2026: Provision Dedicated commit1 (NA reserved pool); finalize autoscaler policies for steady throughput.
  - Mar 2026: Canary live for new latency-sensitive routes; monitor tail-latency and KV cache hit rates.
- EU:
  - Dec 2025: Small H100 pilot (privacy compliance testing).
  - Mar 2026: Dedicated offer discussions with EU enterprise; readiness planning for Dedicated cluster provisioning.
  - Apr 2026: Start dedicated provisioning for commit2; route EU traffic to new pools with canary policies.
- APAC:
  - Feb 2026: H100 validation in APAC (short trial window).
  - May 2026: Gradual scale-up if H100 perf + cost acceptable; otherwise fall back to A100-heavy mix.

Operational notes and dependencies:
- Rack/cabinet provisioning not applicable for cloud Dedicated but inventory lead times for bare-metal partners estimated at 6–10 weeks.
- Network: ensure cross-region egress cost accounting and inter-region fallback policy to avoid surprises.
- Observability: need RL metrics for per-GPU token throughput, KV cache hit rates, and per-route latency SLOs.
- Security: EU Dedicated customers require KMS integration and audit logging by provisioning time (target: before any customer data lands).

Risks & mitigations:
- H100 supply and price volatility -> mitigation: maintain A100 fallback SKU in each region, stage H100 adoption.
- Over-provisioning risk in APAC -> mitigation: strict canary + metrics gating before additional provisioning.
- Enterprise Dedicated deals shift timelines -> mitigation: flexible procurement windows and short-notice burst capacity agreements.

Open questions (needs decisions):
1) Commit thresholds for converting spot/ephemeral capacity into Dedicated reserved capacity (proposed: sustained 14-day 70% utilization signal).
2) APAC pricing threshold for rolling out H100 (proposed: cost-per-effective-hour <= 1.2x NA blended).
3) Autoscaler cool-down policy for multi-tenant Dedicated pools (tradeoff latency vs. cost).

Action items (owners & due dates)
- Diego: finalize H100 procurement quote matrix by 2025-11-20 (JIRA INFRA-3421).
- Lina: run cross-region egress projection and add to billing forecast by 2025-11-28 (PLAT-2987).
- Omar: implement new per-GPU throughput dashboard prototype by 2026-01-15.
- Priya: draft customer-facing note for EU Dedicated compliance timeline by 2025-12-12.

Notes to reviewers: numbers are conservative and biased towards ensuring headroom for canaries and enterprise onboarding. Please flag any demand signals (sales pipeline) or vendor leads that would materially change the ramp schedule.
